text.title: Hipaa Phi Data Flow Design Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable PHI data-flow signals to a rule from `content/01-core-rules.xml`. Every leaf names either a concrete rule id or `skip-this-methodology` when the case is out of scope. Max depth = 2.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the flow carry PHI at all, and if so does the diagram enumerate every hop that touches it, including logs, error trackers, queues, caches, indexes, backups, exports and third-party APIs?

conclusion.verdict: skip-this-methodology: data is de-identified under §164.514(b) or contains no PHI; record the de-identification method and proceed without this design
apply r-phi-every-hop-inventoried: complete the hop inventory with identifier classes per hop before assessing any control

branch.question: For the hop under review, which control is missing: a BAA for an external party, field-level minimum necessary, encryption on a link or store, a per-access audit event, PHI-free logs and URLs, unique identity and role access, a retention and deletion path, or none?

conclusion.verdict: apply r-phi-baa-for-every-external-hop: execute a BAA naming plan and service, or de-identify before the hop, or remove the hop
apply r-phi-minimum-necessary-per-hop: list and justify the fields per hop; de-identify analytics, ML and LLM hops
apply r-phi-encrypted-in-transit-and-at-rest: TLS 1.2+ on every link, KMS-managed at-rest encryption on every store including backups
apply r-phi-audit-event-per-access: emit identity, timestamp, record id, action and source to an append-only store retained six years
apply r-phi-never-in-logs-errors-or-urls: scrub by allow-list, move identifiers out of URLs, add the synthetic-record test
apply r-phi-unique-identity-and-role-access: unique identities, role list per hop, automatic logoff, break-glass with alert
apply r-phi-retention-and-deletion-per-store: declare retention and deletion per store and show propagation to every copy
apply r-phi-audit-event-per-access as the final check: confirm the audit trail and bulk-access alert are live, then route to the Security Officer for sign-off

text.example: Observable: clinical notes are sent to a hosted embeddings API for semantic search; hop inventory complete; the API vendor's plan has no BAA → phi == 'present_hops_complete', control_gap == 'no_baa' → conclusion: r-phi-baa-for-every-external-hop.
